observations.quote: Except in affirming a prior denial or when the denial is self-explanatory, the notice shall be accompanied by a brief statement of the grounds for denial.
observations.rationale: The requirement that notice be accompanied by a brief statement of grounds, along with its specific exceptions for affirming prior denials or self-explanatory denials, is already represented in claim C0001.

observations.quote: Prompt notice shall be given of the denial in whole or in part of a written application, petition, or other request of an interested person made in connection with any agency proceeding.
observations.rationale: The baseline requirement to give prompt notice of denial is already completely and faithfully represented in C0000 with mandatory force ('shall') and full governing scope.
